senses.en: eager to argue or fight; aggressively defiant

ex.en: The truculent customer shouted at every employee in the store.
ex.zh: 那位好鬥的顧客對店裡每個員工大吼。

root.note: 充滿兇猛 → 好鬥的

senses.en: a statement so obviously true that it is hardly worth saying
senses.zh: 不言而喻的道理；老生常談

ex.en: It is a truism that practice makes perfect.
ex.zh: 熟能生巧是個不言而喻的道理。

root.note: 明顯真實的話 → 老生常談

senses.en: telling or expressing the truth; honest

ex.en: Please be truthful about why you missed the meeting.
ex.zh: 請誠實說明你為什麼沒來開會。

senses.en: (of language) pompous, overly complex, and boring
swollen or distended

ex.en: The report's turgid prose made it hard to find the main point.
ex.zh: 報告文字浮誇冗長，很難找出重點。

root.note: 膨脹起來的 → 腫脹的；文字膨脹 → 浮誇的

senses.en: wickedness; depraved behavior

ex.en: The official was fired for moral turpitude after the bribery case.
ex.zh: 那名官員在賄賂案後因道德敗壞而遭免職。

parts.m: base, shameful 卑鄙的（拉丁文 turpis）

root.note: 卑鄙可恥 → 墮落

mn: 法律上常用 moral turpitude（道德敗壞）。

senses.en: protection or guidance, especially by a teacher
guardianship

ex.en: Under the tutelage of a famous chef, he learned to make perfect pastry.
ex.zh: 在名廚的指導下，他學會了做完美的酥皮點心。

parts.m: watch, protect 看護（拉丁文 tueri）

root.note: 看護照顧 → 監護、指導

senses.en: serving as a guardian or protector

ex.en: The villagers believed a tutelar spirit watched over the old well.
ex.zh: 村民相信有一位守護神看守著那口古井。

root.note: 看護著的 → 守護的

senses.en: the position or work of a tutor

ex.en: Under her tutorship, the struggling student passed every exam.
ex.zh: 在她的輔導下，原本吃力的學生通過了每一科考試。

root.note: 導師的身分 → 導師職

senses.en: a sudden, sharp, short pain
a brief pang of emotion

ex.en: She felt a twinge of guilt for eating her roommate's cookies.
ex.zh: 她吃了室友的餅乾，心裡有點內疚。

senses.en: having the usual qualities of a particular type
characteristic of someone's usual behavior

ex.en: A typical school day begins at eight and ends at four.
ex.zh: 典型的上學日從八點開始，四點結束。

root.note: 符合類型模式的 → 典型的

senses.en: to be a typical example of

ex.en: These glass towers typify the city's modern architecture.
ex.zh: 這些玻璃大樓是這座城市現代建築的典型代表。

root.note: 成為某類型的代表 → 作為典型

senses.en: relating to printing or typing
senses.zh: 印刷上的；排版的；打字上的

ex.en: The editor caught a typographical error in the headline.
ex.zh: 編輯在標題中抓到一個打字錯誤。

root.note: 用字模書寫的 → 印刷的

mn: typo（錯字）就是 typographical error 的縮寫。

senses.en: the style and arrangement of printed text
the art or process of printing

ex.en: Good typography makes a website easier to read.
ex.zh: 好的字體排印讓網站更容易閱讀。

root.note: 用字模書寫的技術 → 字體排印

senses.en: using power in a cruel and unfair way

ex.en: The novel is about a village living under a tyrannical landlord.
ex.zh: 這部小說講述一個生活在暴虐地主統治下的村莊。

root.note: 像暴君的 → 暴虐的

senses.en: cruel and oppressive government or rule
cruel or unfair control over others

ex.en: The revolutionaries vowed to fight against tyranny.
ex.zh: 革命者誓言對抗暴政。

root.note: 暴君的統治 → 暴政

senses.en: a beginner or novice

ex.en: As a tyro at chess, he lost every game in the tournament.
ex.zh: 身為西洋棋新手，他在比賽中每局都輸了。

senses.en: (of a reason) hidden or secret, especially selfish
further; beyond what is immediate

ex.en: I suspect he has an ulterior motive for being so helpful.
ex.zh: 我懷疑他那麼熱心是別有用心。

root.note: 在更遠處、看不到的 → 隱藏的

mn: 最常見的片語：ulterior motive（不可告人的動機）。

senses.en: final; being the end result
the best or most extreme of its kind
basic or fundamental

ex.en: The ultimate goal of the project is to provide clean water to every village.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的最終目標是讓每個村莊都有乾淨的水。

root.note: 最遠的 → 最終的

senses.en: a final demand, with a threat of punishment if it is refused

ex.en: The landlord gave them an ultimatum: pay the rent or leave.
ex.zh: 房東給他們下了最後通牒：付房租，不然就搬走。

root.note: 最後的條件 → 最後通牒

senses.en: supporting the supreme authority of the Pope
situated beyond the mountains, especially the Alps
senses.zh: 山那邊的；阿爾卑斯山以南的

ex.en: The ultramontane bishops opposed any limit on papal power.
ex.zh: 主張教皇至上的主教們反對任何限制教皇權力的做法。

root.note: 在山那邊的（從法國看，教廷在阿爾卑斯山另一邊）→ 教皇至上的

senses.en: beyond the physical world or the solar system
senses.zh: 超越塵世的；太陽系以外的

ex.en: Mystics claimed to glimpse an ultramundane realm during meditation.
ex.zh: 神秘主義者聲稱在冥想中瞥見了超越塵世的境界。

root.note: 超越世界的

senses.en: offense or annoyance
(literary) shade or shadow

ex.en: He took umbrage at the suggestion that he had cheated.
ex.zh: 有人暗示他作弊，他為此很不高興。

root.note: 心中蒙上陰影 → 不快

mn: 固定用法 take umbrage at（對…感到不快）；umbrella（傘）同字根。

senses.en: impossible to explain
senses.zh: 無法解釋的；莫名其妙的

senses.en: not responsible to anyone for one's actions
senses.zh: 不必負責的；不受問責的

ex.en: For some unaccountable reason, the lights kept flickering.
ex.zh: 不知為何，燈一直閃個不停。

root.note: 無法說明的 → 莫名其妙的

senses.en: not influenced or changed by something
natural and sincere; not pretentious

ex.en: Towns in the north were unaffected by the flood.
ex.zh: 北部的城鎮沒有受到洪水影響。

root.note: 沒被影響的；沒有故作姿態的 → 自然的

senses.en: complete agreement among everyone involved

ex.en: The jury's decision requires unanimity in criminal cases.
ex.zh: 刑事案件中，陪審團的裁決必須全體一致。

root.note: 大家同一條心 → 全體一致

senses.en: fully agreed on by everyone
senses.zh: 全體一致的；一致同意的

ex.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision to approve the plan.
ex.zh: 委員會一致決定通過這項計畫。

root.note: 同一條心 → 一致的

senses.en: not able to be avoided or prevented

ex.en: Some delays are unavoidable during heavy snowstorms.
ex.zh: 大雪期間，有些延誤是無法避免的。

root.note: 不能避免的

senses.en: too painful or unpleasant to endure
senses.zh: 無法忍受的；難以承受的

ex.en: The summer heat in the classroom was almost unbearable.
ex.zh: 夏天教室裡的高溫幾乎讓人無法忍受。

root.note: 不能忍受的

senses.en: not suitable or proper for a person's position
(of clothing) not flattering

ex.en: Yelling at referees is behavior unbecoming of a team captain.
ex.zh: 對裁判大吼不是隊長該有的得體行為。

root.note: 不合適的 → 不得體的

senses.en: lack of religious belief; skepticism

ex.en: The novel follows a priest struggling with his own unbelief.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫一位與自身信仰動搖掙扎的神父。

root.note: 沒有信仰

senses.en: fair and not influenced by personal opinions

ex.en: We need an unbiased judge to settle the dispute.
ex.zh: 我們需要一位公正的裁判來解決這場爭議。

root.note: 沒有偏斜的 → 公正的

senses.en: uncontrolled; unrestrained

ex.en: The children ran into the pool with unbridled joy.
ex.zh: 孩子們帶著無拘無束的喜悅衝進泳池。

root.note: 沒套上韁繩的 → 不受約束的

senses.en: not happening or found often; unusual
remarkably great

ex.en: It is not uncommon for students to feel stressed before exams.
ex.zh: 學生考前感到壓力並不罕見。

root.note: 不常見的

senses.en: not right or reasonable; morally unacceptable
excessive

ex.en: Charging sick patients such high prices is unconscionable.
ex.zh: 向生病的患者收這麼高的費用實在沒良心。

root.note: 良心（conscience）無法接受的 → 違背良心的

senses.en: not awake and not aware of surroundings
done without realizing
the part of the mind one is not aware of

ex.en: The boxer lay unconscious on the floor for a full minute.
ex.zh: 那名拳擊手昏倒在地上整整一分鐘。

root.note: 不知道周遭的 → 失去知覺的

senses.en: the act of anointing with oil in a religious ceremony
a manner of excessive, insincere earnestness

ex.en: The priest performed the unction at the dying man's bedside.
ex.zh: 神父在臨終者床邊為他施行塗油禮。

root.note: 塗油 → 塗油禮；說話油滑 → 虛情假意

senses.en: excessively and insincerely flattering or polite
senses.zh: 油腔滑調的；虛情假意的

senses.en: greasy or oily

ex.en: The unctuous salesman praised every car I looked at.
ex.zh: 那個油腔滑調的業務員對我看的每輛車都大加讚美。

root.note: 油油的 → 油腔滑調的

senses.en: to free someone from a mistaken belief

ex.en: Someone should undeceive him before he invests all his savings.
ex.zh: 應該有人在他投入所有積蓄之前讓他看清真相。

root.note: 解除欺騙 → 使醒悟

senses.en: to charge less than the proper price

ex.en: The cashier did not mean to undercharge us for the groceries.
ex.zh: 收銀員不是故意少收我們的菜錢。

parts.m: below, too little 在下、不足

root.note: 收費不足 → 少收

senses.en: (of a photograph) too dark because not enough light was used
not given enough publicity or experience
senses.zh: 缺乏曝光的；接觸不足的

ex.en: The photos came out underexposed because the room was so dim.
ex.zh: 房間太暗，照片都曝光不足。

root.note: 放出來見光不足 → 曝光不足的

senses.en: a piece of clothing worn under other clothes

ex.en: Wear a warm undergarment beneath your jacket when skiing.
ex.zh: 滑雪時在外套裡面穿一件保暖內衣。

root.note: 穿在裡面的衣物 → 內衣

senses.en: acting or done secretly and dishonestly
senses.zh: 祕密的；不光明正大的；陰險的

ex.en: The rival company used underhanded tactics to steal clients.
ex.zh: 對手公司用不正當的手段搶客戶。

root.note: 手藏在底下偷偷做 → 不光明的

senses.en: to be the cause or basis of something
senses.zh: 構成…的基礎；是…的根本原因

senses.en: to lie beneath

ex.en: Several factors underlie the rise in housing prices.
ex.zh: 房價上漲背後有好幾個因素。

root.note: 躺在底下 → 構成基礎

senses.en: a person lower in rank, often used disapprovingly

ex.en: The boss never talks to an underling unless something goes wrong.
ex.zh: 老闆除非出了問題，否則從不跟底下的人說話。

root.note: 在下面的小人物 → 嘍囉

senses.en: to provide with too few workers or crew

ex.en: Managers should not underman the night shift during flu season.
ex.zh: 流感季節時，主管不該讓夜班人手不足。

root.note: 配置人手不足

senses.en: to weaken gradually, especially in a secret way
to dig under the base of something
senses.zh: 在…下挖坑道；侵蝕…的基礎

ex.en: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
ex.zh: 不斷的批評會逐漸削弱孩子的自信。

root.note: 在底下挖坑道 → 暗中破壞

senses.en: to underestimate the ability or value of

ex.en: Never underrate the power of a good night's sleep.
ex.zh: 千萬別低估一夜好眠的威力。

root.note: 評價過低 → 低估

senses.en: to sell at a lower price than a competitor
senses.zh: 賤賣；以低於對手的價格出售

senses.en: to present something as less valuable than it is

ex.en: Don't undersell yourself in the job interview.
ex.zh: 求職面試時別貶低自己。

root.note: 賣得比別人低 → 削價出售

senses.en: smaller than usual or than is required
senses.zh: 比一般小的；尺寸不足的

ex.en: Fishermen must throw back any undersized crabs.
ex.zh: 漁民必須把尺寸不足的螃蟹放回海中。

root.note: 尺寸不足的

senses.en: to describe something as smaller or less important than it really is

ex.en: It would understate the problem to call it a small leak.
ex.zh: 把它說成小漏水，就太輕描淡寫這個問題了。

root.note: 說得比實際少 → 輕描淡寫

senses.en: to rate something as less important or valuable than it is

ex.en: Many companies undervalue the work of customer service staff.
ex.zh: 很多公司低估了客服人員的工作價值。

root.note: 估價過低

senses.en: the world of organized crime
(in myths) the world of the dead beneath the earth

ex.en: In Greek myth, Hades ruled the underworld.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，黑帝斯統治冥界。

root.note: 地底下的世界 → 冥界；社會底層的世界 → 黑社會

senses.en: to agree to pay for or financially support
to accept financial risk, as in insurance

ex.en: A local bank agreed to underwrite the cost of the festival.
ex.zh: 一家地方銀行同意負擔這個節慶的費用。

root.note: 在文件下方簽名擔保 → 承保、資助

senses.en: more than is necessary or reasonable; excessive

ex.en: The new rules put undue pressure on small businesses.
ex.zh: 新規定對小型企業造成過度的壓力。

root.note: 超出應有的 → 過度的

senses.en: to move or be shaped like waves

ex.en: Fields of wheat undulate gently in the summer breeze.
ex.zh: 麥田在夏日微風中輕輕起伏。

root.note: 像小波浪一樣 → 起伏

senses.en: wavy; rising and falling like waves

ex.en: The painter captured the undulous hills beneath a pale sky.
ex.zh: 畫家捕捉到淡色天空下起伏的山丘。

root.note: 像小波浪的 → 波浪狀的

senses.en: expressing disapproval
not helpful or advantageous

ex.en: Unfavorable weather forced the launch to be delayed.
ex.zh: 不利的天候迫使發射延期。

root.note: 不支持的 → 不利的

senses.en: awkward and clumsy in movement

ex.en: The newborn giraffe took a few ungainly steps.
ex.zh: 剛出生的長頸鹿笨拙地走了幾步。

senses.en: a soft, greasy substance used on skin or wounds

ex.en: The healer rubbed a soothing unguent on the burn.
ex.zh: 治療師在燙傷處塗上舒緩的藥膏。

root.note: 塗抹的油膏 → 藥膏

senses.en: made up of a single cell

ex.en: Bacteria are unicellular organisms.
ex.zh: 細菌是單細胞生物。

root.note: 只有一個細胞的

senses.en: to bring together to form a single unit

ex.en: The new leader promised to unify the divided country.
ex.zh: 新領導人承諾要統一這個分裂的國家。

root.note: 使成為一體 → 統一

senses.en: being the only one of its kind
very special or unusual

ex.en: Each snowflake has a unique pattern.
ex.zh: 每一片雪花都有獨一無二的圖案。

root.note: 只有一個的 → 獨一無二的

senses.en: the act of doing or saying something at the same time
the same musical pitch sung or played together

ex.en: The students answered in unison, "Good morning, teacher!"
ex.zh: 學生們齊聲回答：「老師早！」

root.note: 同一個聲音 → 齊聲、一致

mn: 常用 in unison（一齊、一致）。

senses.en: having the same pitch; in unison

ex.en: The two flutes played a unisonant melody.
ex.zh: 兩支長笛吹奏同音的旋律。

root.note: 發出同一個聲音的 → 同音的

senses.en: a member of a Christian group that believes God is one being, rejecting the Trinity
relating to the Unitarians

ex.en: The town's Unitarian church welcomes people of many beliefs.
ex.zh: 鎮上的一位論派教會歡迎各種信仰的人。

root.note: 相信神是唯一一體的人 → 一位論派

senses.en: (chemistry) the property of having a valence of one

ex.en: The univalence of sodium explains why it forms simple salts with chlorine.
ex.zh: 鈉的一價特性說明了它為何能和氯形成簡單的鹽類。

root.note: 一個價數 → 一價

senses.en: not allowed by law; illegal

ex.en: It is unlawful to drive without a valid license.
ex.zh: 無照駕駛是違法的。

root.note: 不合法的

senses.en: not limited in number, amount, or extent

ex.en: The phone plan includes unlimited data for one month.
ex.zh: 這個手機方案包含一個月的無限上網。

root.note: 沒有界限的

senses.en: different from what is normal or found in nature
forced or affected

ex.en: Her smile in the photo looked stiff and unnatural.
ex.zh: 她在照片裡的笑容看起來很僵硬、不自然。

root.note: 不自然的

senses.en: not needed

ex.en: Please avoid unnecessary travel during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間請避免不必要的外出。

root.note: 不是必要的

senses.en: to make someone anxious or uneasy
to disturb the stability of

ex.en: Sudden changes in routine can unsettle young children.
ex.zh: 作息突然改變會讓小孩感到不安。

root.note: 使不再安定 → 使不安

senses.en: lacking worldly experience or refined taste
simple; not complicated

ex.en: The early computers were unsophisticated by today's standards.
ex.zh: 以今天的標準來看，早期電腦很陽春。

root.note: 不世故的 → 單純的

senses.en: too bad or horrific to be expressed in words
senses.zh: 說不出口的；極其惡劣的

senses.en: (of a feeling) too great to be described

ex.en: The survivors described unspeakable conditions in the camp.
ex.zh: 倖存者描述了營中駭人聽聞的處境。

root.note: 無法說出口的

senses.en: happening too soon or at the wrong time

ex.en: The musician's untimely death shocked his fans.
ex.zh: 這位音樂家英年早逝，讓歌迷非常震驚。

root.note: 不合時的

senses.en: unexpected and inappropriate or inconvenient

ex.en: The guard reported that nothing untoward happened during the night.
ex.zh: 警衛報告說夜裡一切正常，沒發生什麼異狀。

senses.en: too great or awful to be described in words

ex.en: She felt unutterable relief when her son walked through the door.
ex.zh: 看到兒子走進門，她感到說不出的寬慰。

root.note: 說不出來的

senses.en: hard to carry or move because of size or weight
(of a system) too large or complex to work well

ex.en: The old sofa was too unwieldy to carry up the stairs.
ex.zh: 那張舊沙發太笨重，搬不上樓。

root.note: 不好操控的 → 笨重的

senses.en: showing poor judgment; foolish

ex.en: It would be unwise to hike alone without telling anyone.
ex.zh: 不告訴任何人就獨自健行是不明智的。

root.note: 不明智的

senses.en: to release animals from a yoke
to set free from a burden or bond

ex.en: At sunset the farmer would unyoke the oxen and lead them home.
ex.zh: 日落時，農夫會卸下牛軛，把牛牽回家。

root.note: 解開軛 → 解除束縛

senses.en: the process or cost of keeping something in good condition

ex.en: The up-keep of a large house can be very expensive.
ex.zh: 大房子的維護費用可能非常高。

root.note: 保持在良好狀態 → 維修保養

senses.en: to scold or criticize severely

ex.en: The coach did not upbraid the players after the loss; he encouraged them.
ex.zh: 輸球後教練沒有責罵球員，反而鼓勵他們。

senses.en: directed or thrown upward
a shaft through which air leaves a mine

ex.en: She prayed silently with upcast eyes.
ex.zh: 她抬眼向上，默默祈禱。

root.note: 向上投 → 朝上的

senses.en: a sudden, violent change or disruption
an upward movement of the earth's surface

ex.en: The war caused great social and economic upheaval.
ex.zh: 這場戰爭造成了巨大的社會與經濟動盪。

root.note: 被猛然向上掀起 → 劇變

senses.en: to lift or be lifted forcefully upward

ex.en: The earthquake could upheave whole sections of the coast.
ex.zh: 地震可能讓整段海岸隆起。

root.note: 向上舉起

senses.en: highest in position or rank
most important in one's mind

ex.en: Safety was uppermost in the pilot's mind during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中，飛行員心中最重視的是安全。

root.note: 最上面的

senses.en: very noisy and full of excitement
extremely funny

ex.en: The comedian's uproarious show left the audience in tears.
ex.zh: 這位喜劇演員爆笑的表演讓觀眾笑到流淚。

root.note: 一片喧鬧的

senses.en: to pull a plant out of the ground with its roots
to force someone to leave their home
senses.zh: 使離開家園；使流離失所

ex.en: The typhoon managed to uproot dozens of trees along the road.
ex.zh: 颱風把路旁數十棵樹連根拔起。

root.note: 把根往上拔起

senses.en: an improvement or upward trend, especially in the economy
[ʌpˋtɝn] to turn something upward or upside down

ex.en: Shops are hoping for an upturn in sales during the holidays.
ex.zh: 商店希望假期期間銷售能夠回升。

root.note: 向上轉 → 好轉

senses.en: relating to a city or town

ex.en: More than half the world's people now live in urban areas.
ex.zh: 如今全世界超過一半的人口住在都市地區。

root.note: 城市的

senses.en: polished courtesy and sophistication in manner
urban life or character

ex.en: The ambassador handled the tense dinner with charm and urbanity.
ex.zh: 大使以魅力與優雅得體的風度化解了晚宴的緊張氣氛。

root.note: 城市人的舉止 → 溫文儒雅

senses.en: a poor, often dirty and mischievous child
short for sea urchin

ex.en: A barefoot urchin begged for coins outside the train station.
ex.zh: 一個赤腳的小孩在火車站外討零錢。

mn: 原意是「刺蝟」，海膽 sea urchin 就是「海裡的刺蝟」。

senses.en: importance that requires quick action

ex.en: The doctor's tone showed the urgency of the situation.
ex.zh: 醫生的語氣顯示出情況的緊急。

root.note: 被催促著 → 緊急

senses.en: the way in which words are normally used
the action or amount of using something

ex.en: Water usage rises sharply during the hot summer months.
ex.zh: 炎熱的夏季月份用水量急劇上升。

root.note: 使用的方式或數量

senses.en: charging extremely high interest on loans
senses.zh: 放高利貸的；利息過高的

ex.en: The payday lender charged usurious rates of over 300 percent.
ex.zh: 那家發薪日貸款業者收取超過 300% 的高利貸利率。

root.note: 收取過高利息的

senses.en: to take a position of power illegally or by force

ex.en: The general tried to usurp the throne while the king was abroad.
ex.zh: 將軍趁國王出國時企圖篡奪王位。

senses.en: the practice of lending money at extremely high interest

ex.en: Many medieval laws banned usury as a sin.
ex.zh: 許多中世紀法律把放高利貸視為罪行而加以禁止。

root.note: 借錢給人使用而收取費用 → 高利貸

senses.en: the belief that the right action is the one that produces the greatest good for the most people

ex.en: Utilitarianism judges actions only by their results.
ex.zh: 功利主義只根據結果來評斷行為。

root.note: 以效用為依歸的主義 → 功利主義

senses.en: the state of being useful or beneficial
a public service such as electricity, water, or gas

ex.en: Our monthly rent does not include utility bills.
ex.zh: 我們的月租不包含水電瓦斯費。

root.note: 可使用的性質 → 效用

senses.en: greatest; most extreme
the greatest amount or extent possible

ex.en: This matter is of the utmost importance.
ex.zh: 這件事極為重要。

root.note: 最外面的、最遠的 → 極度的

mn: 常見片語 do one's utmost（盡最大努力）、of the utmost importance（極其重要）。

senses.en: to leave a place so it becomes empty
to give up a position or job
(law) to cancel or annul

ex.en: Guests must vacate their rooms by noon.
ex.zh: 房客必須在中午前退房。

root.note: 使變空 → 空出
